population: Six registered source windows, two source fruit demonstrations. Four frozen input profiles O0_NATIVE, O1_VISION_ONLY, O1_STATE_ONLY, O1A_MISSING_LEFT from existing calls, same input frame and PRNG key. Two exact repeats excluded from independent population. Sixteen Go2 TRAIN windows in six teacher episodes. Use all and keep overlap explicit.
question: Within the exact 49/30 s future represented by a raw frozen return, did the contemporaneous expert actually request CLOSE or OPEN, and did the right arm model reproduce the event? Does substituting missing visual/arm channels on the same source example remove an ability present on native source?
sources: Check original HDF5 demo versus the saved native expert rows, and original model return versus the signed native arrays/call journal and sealed factorial results. Target teacher uses complete applied 25-tick command records already validated against 2ms motor traces; use native_start_step and physical 0.044 * installed_EEF10[9]. Report previous applied command and boundary events separately. Teacher futures and stage only for scoring.
events: Fixed source-unit down through .55 and up through .65, target thresholds .002+.040*g metres. Expert source and policy are linear between 30 Hz knots; target teacher command is ZOH from the native start tick (discrete step), never interpolate its crossing onto 30 Hz. Score events strictly after first forecast knot through 49/30 inclusive. Record any right-at-query teacher change separately, compare source measured/reference initial values separately if defined; do not manufacture a model boundary event. Direction-ordered exact sequence, CLOSE and OPEN marginal counts, matched times only for equal ordered sequences, normalized width RMSE vs expert on common 50 query times and last-command hold baseline. Raw horizon comparison in nominal source time independent of the C2 execution schedule. Null and empty predictions reported separately.
limits: Pure frozen archive. No new training, GPU, native integrations, camera ablation or long-horizon claim. This is a diagnostic of a previously seen panel rather than a held-out experiment. Retain profile and phase denominators, unique target bursts across overlapping windows, and distinguish source demonstrations from physical grasp truth.
